allow_paid_downloads.description: Spends your account's download tokens. Off by default. When on, and a username and password or a session cookie is set, the provider may buy subtitles that cost no more than the Maximum tokens per download setting, for automatic and manual downloads alike. When off, token-priced subtitles are not offered and no tokens are ever spent.
allow_paid_downloads.title: Allow token-priced downloads

flaresolverr_timeout_ms.description: Maximum time FlareSolverr may spend clearing a Cloudflare challenge.
flaresolverr_timeout_ms.title: FlareSolverr timeout (ms)

flaresolverr_url.description: Optional. FlareSolverr /v1 endpoint, used only if prijevodi-online.org starts answering with a Cloudflare challenge. The site does not challenge requests today, so leave it empty unless searches fail with a Cloudflare error. Sign-in details and session cookies are never sent to FlareSolverr.
flaresolverr_url.title: FlareSolverr URL

max_tokens_per_download.description: The most the provider may pay for one subtitle when token-priced downloads are on. Prices fall with age: a series subtitle costs 5 tokens in its first week, 2 until day 14, then 1. A movie subtitle costs 5, 3 and 2 until days 7, 21 and 60, then 1. At 1, Bazarr's regular searches pick a subtitle up once its price has dropped to 1.
max_tokens_per_download.title: Maximum tokens per download

request_delay_ms.description: Optional pause between requests to prijevodi-online.org. The provider already slows down by itself when the site's rate limit runs low.
request_delay_ms.title: Delay between requests (ms)

session_cookie.description: Optional, instead of a username and password. Sign in on www.prijevodi-online.org in your browser, open the developer tools, pick any request to /api/v1/ in the Network tab and copy its whole Cookie request header here. It is used first when set. It stops working when that browser session ends, including when you sign out in the browser.
session_cookie.title: Session cookie (optional)

session_user_agent.description: Only needed if the site rejects the session cookie from Bazarr. Paste the User-Agent of the browser the cookie came from.
session_user_agent.title: Browser User-Agent for the session cookie (optional)

username.description: Optional. Leave empty to use the provider without an account: search and every download the site allows visitors keep working. Movie subtitles need an account, because the site does not let visitors download movies; without one, movie searches find nothing to download. With an account the provider can also download what the site keeps for members. The site protects its sign-in page with a Cloudflare Turnstile captcha. If Bazarr cannot sign in with a username and password, use the session cookie field instead.
username.title: Username (optional)

description: Uses the Prijevodi-Online API for Croatian, Serbian (Latin and Cyrillic), Bosnian, Montenegrin, Macedonian, and Serbo-Croatian episode and movie subtitles. Series work without an account: search always works, and downloads work wherever the site lets visitors download. Movie subtitles need an account, because the site does not let visitors download movies. An optional account, signed in with a username and password or a browser session cookie, adds member downloads and, only after you turn on token-priced downloads, spends the account's tokens up to the per-download limit you set. ZIP and RAR downloads are supported.
name: Prijevodi-Online
